record: QANDEEL CI-01 C1-B — Synthetic Intelligence Reality Baseline (results)
readThisFirst: SYNTHETIC fixtures only; no real user, no real conversation, no provider. Every text here is from scripts/ci-01/fixtures.
Run success (this file exists, status RUN) is NOT a capability pass. Yields below record what the deterministic pipeline did, including its defects.
Nothing here is a conversational-quality, naturalness or calibration figure, and nothing predicts what a bound LLM would do (D7).
Defects are recorded, not repaired (C1 contract §0.4, decision 3). Owners stay in the canonical backlog; this file assigns none.

U1.title: A FORGET clarification answered in words: the forgotten Memory is never re-created (MEM-AR-01C R2 regression; MEM-AR-01B S-2a, INTEL-TM-01 R2)
U1.purpose: MEM-AR-01B characterized R2 here (results 3d0ff0f…: the answer re-created the forgotten Memory and U1.5 served it again; that file stays as the regression evidence). Since MEM-AR-01C the background writer refuses a turn a Memory command answered (SKIPPED_COMMAND_TURN): the FORGET asks which one, the user answers in words («أنا بحب الكشري»), the foreground forgets the chosen Memory, the background writes nothing, and U1.5 must not serve the forgotten statement (forgottenServed false). Records the command, the option chosen, the status change, the background MEMORY_WRITE effect and any new row.
